input.input: const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,240p' /home/kafka/.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md && git status --short && git log --oneline --decorate -8",workdir:"/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:12000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,240p' docs/agents/issue-tracker.md; git diff --stat a1867c3...HEAD; git diff --name-only a1867c3...HEAD; git log a1867c3..HEAD --oneline",workdir:"/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:12000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"gh pr view 21 --comments; gh issue view 14 --comments; gh issue view 12 --comments",workdir:"/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:20000}); text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"gh pr view 21 --json title,body,commits,files,statusCheckRollup; gh issue view 14 --json title,body,comments,labels; gh issue view 12 --json title,body,comments,labels",workdir:"/home/kafka/code/costco-chicken-tracker",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:30000}); text(r.output);
